observable_requests.affirmative_interpretation: The panel has a compact, predominantly triangular figure with a densely articulated raster boundary, many corners, and strongly oblique edge transitions.

panel_descriptions.neg_0: A sparse four-armed, self-crossing angular figure drawn with smooth solid strokes.
panel_descriptions.neg_1: A tilted outlined rectangle joined corner-to-corner to a small outlined triangle.
panel_descriptions.neg_2: Two attached polygonal loops: a lower-left triangle-like loop and an upper-right quadrilateral, with rows of circles on several edges and solid strokes on others.
panel_descriptions.neg_3: A narrow tilted outlined rectangle joined to a small outlined triangle.
panel_descriptions.neg_4: A large tilted quadrilateral joined to a much smaller triangular cluster; circles, squares, zigzags, and solid strokes decorate different sides.
panel_descriptions.neg_5: Two long crossing solid strokes with a small triangular wedge beside the crossing.
panel_descriptions.pos_0: A large right-pointing triangular loop joined at its left vertex to a small irregular loop; squares, circles, and a dense black zigzag articulate the edges.
panel_descriptions.pos_1: A large inverted triangular loop joined near its lower vertex to a small rounded polygonal loop; repeated triangles, squares, circles, and black zigzags form the boundary.
panel_descriptions.pos_2: A large triangular loop joined near its right vertex to a small downward triangular loop; squares, circles, triangles, zigzags, and one solid oblique side articulate the figure.
panel_descriptions.pos_3: A narrow downward triangular loop joined at its upper-left vertex to a small rounded loop; squares, circles, triangles, and black zigzags cover most edges.
panel_descriptions.pos_4: A broad triangular loop joined at its lower-left vertex to a small irregular loop; thick zigzags dominate the large loop and small squares, circles, and triangles articulate the remaining edges.
panel_descriptions.pos_5: A tall triangular loop joined near its right vertex to a small rectangular-rounded loop; solid and zigzag sides form the large triangle, while squares and circles form the small loop.
